tail_vs_percentile_interval.interpretation: Tail rejection p_bayes < 0.025 and percentile-interval exclusion of zero are distinct finite-draw summaries. Zero-valued quantiles/ties can produce a tail-only rejection; these are reported separately and are not classified as aggregate corruption.

inputs.method: direct pandas/numpy finite-row group recomputation from per_replication.csv; no collector or aggregate helper invoked

notes: For decision estimands ending in any/any_bonf, only finite p_bayes and truth determine n and rejection; point/interval metrics and their MCSE/count fields remain missing.
Tail rejection and percentile interval exclusion of zero are checked separately because finite posterior draws may have ties at zero.
Application per-replication truth is unavailable, application outputs contain no truth/error/evaluation columns, and truth-based scalar/surface metrics contain simulation phases only.

Each diagnostic cell has 6,000 per-replication rows (30 estimands x 200 reps); the audit checks 200 unique reps per estimand. The initial aggregate-level row-count condition was corrected to this structure, and no cell is missing or duplicating reps.

scalar_recomputation.comparison_tolerance: absolute 5e-10 + relative 5e-10; count fields exact to 1e-12

main_rate1_donor.conclusion: All 1,200 prior-rate sensitivity jobs map uniquely to a main-phase sigma2_rate=1 donor with identical model/DGP configuration and rep seed index.
main_rate1_donor.scope_note: Configuration/seed donor verified from the frozen parent manifest. Main rate-1 result rows are not in this non-main collection; collected 0.1/10 results were separately checked for paired truth equality.
